answer: An admission auction blocks identity forgery. Each epoch the network opens a terrace of 100 seats, sold to the highest bidders, each bid sealed in a jade token. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake agents must outbid honest agents 1,000 times: at 50 POA a seat that costs 50,000 POA, far more than those ghosts could earn. The ripple spreads further, since each fake bid pushes the price up. Honest agents pay once and share rewards fakes cannot dilute.
